decisions_r4: W9-D9 Table III / LUT / simulation value = pooled gross mean of the valid sessions (what the device draws on the VBUS -> REG0 path on average); uncertainty = range of the session means, cycle-level CI95 also reported

W9-D10 core E (intercept at high fraction 0) and the mean high fraction are reported next to every pooled E_dev / E_prot as the reproducibility measure and the lower envelope (REG0 always in its low mode)

W9-D11 week 13 D0/D4 cross-day rule, pre-declared before the data: raw |delta| < 10 % per s (plan) AND core |delta| <= 2 % (s >= 2) / <= 8 % (s <= 1); raw fails + core passes = REG0 mode share (documented), core fails = real change, investigate before D5
W9-D12 E7 simulation: base = pooled mean, sensitivity with the session min and max
